DB_1_01.TXT:
On orders from MARZ Command, you enter the
Equatorial Sector of the Mars Front to search
for the missing Sergeant Hatter, only to be
confronted there by a series of anomalies.

A covert plot to rig the Limited Wars, which by
rights should be fought fairly, has come to
light, along with a shadowy organization that
obstructs Public Security's intervention.
DB_1_02.TXT:
MARZ Command has launched a large-scale
investigation to expose the mysterious
shadowy organization.

Sent to the Jupiter sphere as part of the
operation, you make contact with the Rose
Sisters and obtain information concerning the
Daimon Fragments.

But clashes with the combat crystals Ajim and
Gelan entangle the situation ever more
deeply.
DB_1_03.TXT:
Transported to Earth by a mysterious
presence, you are reunited with the Rose
Sisters.

The clue they offer for escaping the Forbidden
Zone is an enigmatic crystalline body known
as the Wild Crystal.

MARZ Command, however, is reluctant to
disclose information about the Wild Crystal.

Unable to hide his frustration with their
response, Sergeant Hatter resolves to leave
the front.

After a desperate battle with Yagarande, the
escape from the Forbidden Zone is at last
achieved, but before your eyes stands an
unknown threat: Daimon.
DB_1_04.TXT:
The Moon Gate: a colossal ruin of non-human
origin. On the Moon, Shadow VRs running amok
under its influence drive you into a corner.

Clearia Biasten, a White Rainbow Knight sworn
to annihilate the Shadows, surmises the cause
of their mass appearance and leads you to the
Moon Gate.

There, he sets you a trial: to defeat your own
Shadow with your own hands. That is the best
means of correcting the distortion that has
arisen.

When you overcome the trial, the time comes
to part with the White Rainbow Knight. But
soon after, a further threat appears: Daimon.
DB_1_05.TXT:
The Jupiter Crystal had been hidden by
Daimon in the Mars Polar Cap Theater.

To retake it, MARZ launches an offensive
against Daimon across the entire Mars Front.
But the International War Corporation, which
stages the Limited Wars on the Mars Front,
and combat contractors such as DNA, RNA
and SHBVD have all effectively sunk to the
level of Daimon's subsidiaries, and now openly
rise in revolt against MARZ.
DB_1_06.TXT:
Lurking within Cyber Imaginary Space,
Daimon's Event Collapse Fortress, stirred by
the spatial distortion created by the Jupiter
Crystal's relocation, is about to unleash its
terrible power.

To stop this ultimate weapon, which would
bring every event occurring in real space to
collapse, the Daimon Fragments are needed.

But the Fragments not yet recovered are held
by the giant mobile fortresses under Daimon's
command.

To seize them, you take on the arduous
mission of racing back and forth between
Earth, the Moon, Jupiter and Mars.
DB_1_07.TXT:
The recovery of the Daimon Fragments is
complete, and the Gate of Tangram, the
entrance to the Cyber Imaginary Space where
the Event Collapse Fortress lurks, has been
opened.

Receiving your orders in person from Lilin
Plajiner, Supreme Commander of MARZ, you
carry out a special mission to storm the
fortress.

It is also a mission to rescue Tangram, the
trump card for driving a breakthrough point
into the stagnant historical inertia of
humanity.

Now the goddess of fate rises from the depths
of a night stagnant with languid heat, and
gazes upon the delusions of mankind. Her
breath is soft, keeping time with the heartbeat
of a new legend...
DB_2_01.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
MZV-707-S
TEMJIN 707S


■ Overview ■
In its early days, MARZ met its need for a
main battle unit with modified machines based
on the MBV-707, supplied by the giant
corporate nation "Fresh Lifo".

Adopting the Adax Corporation's VOX-series
VRs was also considered, but the idea was
shelved because the company took a negative
stance toward the very existence of MARZ.

Required to deliver sure-win performance for
keeping the peace in the Mars sphere, this unit
was thoroughly tuned, gaining a formidable
combat capability that far surpasses the
conventional 707 series.

A minor-change version of this unit with
improved performance also exists,
distinguished by the model number
MZV-707-S/V.


■ Armament ■
LW: Power Bomb Mk3

RW: Sleipnir Mk4
        Neutral Launcher
CW: Sleipnir Mk4
        Blitz Saber
DB_2_02.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
MZV-747J
TEMJIN 747J


■ Overview ■
To keep the Limited Wars fought with VRs in
the Mars sphere running properly, MARZ did
not shrink from the use of force.

This demanded sure-win armaments, and even
its mainstay Temjin-series units were given
lavish tuning with no regard for cost.

The unit called the 747J is a super weapon
with otherworldly potential, in a different
class entirely from units of the same series
fielded by existing Corporate Armies (CA) such
as DNA.

A minor-change version of this unit with
improved performance also exists,
distinguished by the model number
MZV-747-J/V.


■ Armament ■
LW: Power Bomb Mk5d

RW: Sleipnir Mk6mz
      Neutral Launcher
CW: Sleipnir Mk6mz
      Blitz Saber
DB_2_03.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
MZV-747-H│
TEMJIN 747H│


■ Overview ■
The 747H│ is an enhanced unit built with
lavish, unstinting use of high-performance
components, with heavy firepower and heavy
armor as its focus, to root out crime on an
increasingly vicious Mars Front.

As a result, it came to possess potential such
that it may fairly be called an entirely
different machine from the 747H sold as a
regular commercial model.

A minor-change version of this unit with
improved performance also exists,
distinguished by the model number
MZV-747-H│A.


■ Armament ■
LW: Duster Bomb Mk5

RW: Cloud Slap Mk1mz

CW: Shoulder Launcher KLS-24-C
DB_2_04.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
MBV-707-J
TEMJIN 707J


■ Overview ■
Put into service in VCa4, the MBV-707 was
improved repeatedly during the Oratorio
Tangram War, reaching its finished form in the
J type.

Though this unit was once unrivaled, it tended
to be optimized for use in the Earth sphere,
and on the Mars Front, where battle must be
fought under the influence of the Mars Crystal,
which hinders V-Converter operation, it could
hardly lay claim to the title of strongest.


■ Armament ■
LW: Power Bomb Mk3

RW: Sleipnir Mk4
        Neutral Launcher
CW: Sleipnir Mk4
        Blitz Saber
DB_2_05.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
MBV-04-10/80adv
10/80adv


■ Overview ■
The Adax Corporation, the largest VR
development plant in the Earth sphere, sought
to open up a market where it could take the
initiative, and set its sights on Mars.

But this planet posed one serious problem.

Because the Mars Crystal inhibits the activity
of the V-Converters mounted in VRs, existing
second-generation VRs could not deliver
adequate performance.

The company was thus pressed to develop a
new VR that could operate without trouble
even under the Crystal's influence.

The result was the series of units known as
"VOX", but before that, a variety of
experiments were conducted with 10/80s
brought in from the Earth sphere in large
numbers as research material. (Adax was
sitting on a large stock of 10/80s, which had
become obsolete older models.)

The 10/80adv, born in the course of these
many trials, was a modified unit for operational
testing of the filter circuits common to all
third-generation VRs.

It can therefore operate on Mars, but being
strictly a test unit, its performance as a
weapon is very poor. Sales through official
channels were accordingly forgone.

On the Mars Front, however, many theaters lie
outside the jurisdiction of the International
War Corporation and Adax, and in such places
no few dealers trade in non-standard
weapons, so the sale of clearly inferior goods
at low prices never ceased.


■ Armament ■
LW: Power Bomb Mk.2

RW: CGS type b2/e

CW: CGS type b2/e
DB_2_06.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
HBV-512-E2
RAIDEN 512E2


■ Overview ■
The standard Raiden.

Its combination of the Bazooka Launcher and
the "Binary Lotus" laser unit boasts
outstanding stability.

Making the most of its innately high attack
power and defense, it was used heavily, mainly
for defensive battles in fierce combat zones,
and achieved great results.


■ Armament ■
LW: G-Bomb G-09

RW: Bazooka Launcher Zig-21

CW: Laser Unit Binary Lotus
DB_2_07.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
HBV-512-E1
RAIDEN 512E1


■ Overview ■
A unit whose attack profile is concentrated on
a single point.

Beyond the acclaimed "Binary Lotus" laser unit,
the Flat Launcher, which unleashes astonishing
destructive power when it hits home, gives it
potential beyond the bounds of a heavy
combat VR built for fire suppression from out
of range.


■ Armament ■
LW: G-Bomb G-09

RW: Flat Launcher Zap-11

CW: Laser Unit Binary Lotus
DB_2_08.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
VOX D-101
Dan


■ Overview ■
A support VR.

A sturdy, highly cost-effective unit, it was
used in great numbers on every battlefield.

Combat groups made up of VOX-series units
were a standard force on the Mars Front, and
a source of dread for units newly arriving from
the Earth sphere.


■ Armament ■
LW: Arm Box Launcher
        ABL-B27
RW: Arm Box Launcher
        ABL-M32
CW: Shoulder Box Launcher
        SBL-M18
DB_2_09.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
VOX J-500
Joe


■ Overview ■
An attack VR.

An excellent unit that packs above-standard
firepower and armor into a compact design, it
was prized in every theater as the linchpin of
attack power.


■ Armament ■
LW: MALS-H09

RW: Ejectable Claw Launcher
        ECL-A/N54
CW: Shoulder Box Launcher
        SBL-P25
DB_2_10.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
VOX J-504
Jane


■ Overview ■
An attack VR.

A variant of the same model as Joe, with its
weapon layout reversed left to right.

Like Joe, it is an excellent unit that packs
above-standard firepower and armor into a
compact design.


■ Armament ■
LW: Ejectable Claw Launcher
        ECL-A/N54
RW: MALS-C22

CW: Shoulder Box Launcher
        SBL-P25
DB_2_11.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
VOX B-240
Bob1


■ Overview ■
A heavy combat VR made by the Adax
Corporation.

Making use of armor one rank heavier than the
Joe series, it was deployed in concentrated
numbers as a shock force to break through
lines, or as the linchpin of base defense, and
was highly regarded.


■ Armament ■
LW: MALS-D21

RW: Ejectable Claw Launcher
        ECL-A/N54
CW: Cutter Launcher
        SBL-C32
DB_2_12.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
VOX B-242
Bob2


■ Overview ■
A heavy combat VR made by the Adax
Corporation, and a variant of the same model
as Bob1.

When mass-producing the VOX series, the
Adax Corporation ran several of its plants at
once, and as a result even a single model
exists in several different types. The Bob
series, and Joe and Jane, are typical
examples.

Like Bob1, this unit was deployed in
concentrated numbers as a shock force to
break through lines, or as the linchpin of base
defense, and was highly regarded.


■ Armament ■
LW: MALS-D21

RW: Ejectable Claw Launcher
        ECL-A/N54
CW: Cutter Launcher
        SBL-C32
DB_2_13.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
VOX L-48
Lee


■ Overview ■
The first model of the VOX series.

A light combat VR developed to carry on the
concept of the Adax Corporation's
second-generation "VOK" (Bock) series of
VRs.

Though unreliable for anti-VR combat, the
benefits of its light build, above all its
good mobility, suited it to roles such as
reconnaissance in force, and it served
actively, mainly on patrol and search duty.


■ Armament ■
LW: NOTHING

RW: NOTHING

CW: Miroff Gun System 106
        MLF-GS 106
DB_2_14.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
VOX L-43
Loo


■ Overview ■
A model developed after Lee, belonging to the
early VOX series.

Its main purpose was testing such things as
the hardpoints for mounting weapons on both
shoulders, so it has more the character of a
prototype.

Lacking the forearm attack units of later
models in the series such as Dan, its combat
ability is middling, but it is correspondingly
light, cheap and easy to handle, and even
poorly trained pilots can master it easily, so
it was widely used on every front.


■ Armament ■
LW: NOTHING

RW: NOTHING

CW: Shoulder Box Launcher
        SBL-M13
DB_2_15.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
RVR-24-C
APHARMD J typeC


■ Overview ■
The Apharmd line's traditional close-combat
decisive-battle unit.

The design was completely renewed to
actively pursue a more compact frame, and as
a result it became far easier to operate than
its second-generation counterparts.

A fine unit, highly rated for its nimble
mobility and solid combat power.


■ Armament ■
LW: Super Bomb typeM

RW: Dakias Gun System
        DKS type a6/59
CW: Dynamic Tonfa ver.SX
DB_2_16.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
RVR-20-A
APHARMD J typeA


■ Overview ■
The mainstay model of the Apharmd J line.

While inheriting the design concept of the
second-generation Apharmd C type, it
underwent various improvements and
downsizing to optimize it for the Mars Front.

An outstanding unit, easy to operate and
boasting good cost-effectiveness in a
different sense from the VOX series.


■ Armament ■
LW: Super Bomb typeD

RW: Gun Launcher R-24

CW: Terminus Machete
DB_2_17.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
RVR-36-F
APHARMD T typeF


■ Overview ■
An attack VR developed to serve as a shock
force that relies on sheer firepower.

It resembles the second-generation RVR-32,
but is used in a very different way.


■ Armament ■
LW: Super Bomb type M

RW: Max Launcher F-13

CW: Tiger Cannon T-11
DB_2_18.TXT:
■ Unit Name ■
RVR-62-D
APHARMD T typeD


■ Overview ■
A support unit filling the niche that, in the
VOX series, corresponds to the D-100 series
(Dan and others).

Extremely sturdy and seldom breaking down, it
enjoyed an excellent reputation at the front.


■ Armament ■
LW: Super Bomb type D

RW: Gun Launcher R-24

CW: Tiger Launcher G-21
